info.name: Class Management API — MVP-7.5 (Polish, Live Settings & Realtime)
info.description:
MVP-7.5 polish flows: live system settings (app_name via public config, invite-code length, max-students-per-class cap), maintenance mode (503 for non-admin writes), and the richer admin dashboard (counters + 30-day new-user trend + status breakdowns). Realtime notifications use SignalR (WebSocket at /hubs/notifications) — verify manually in the browser, not via Postman. Cookie auth via the jar; folders re-login to switch actor. Run 0→4 against a freshly-seeded local API; reuse the 'Class Management — Local' environment.

Note: the 'Approve member #1' step needs the membership id in {{m1}} — fetch it first via GET /teacher/classes/{{classId}}/members?status=Pending (the collection does this for you).
